attributes.action: Introduce safeguards to stop misuse of Lasting Power of Attorney powers
attributes.additional_details:
LPAs give attorneys significant power, but limited oversight can exclude families from important health, welfare and financial information.
We ask the Government to introduce:
* Automatic notification of close family members when an LPA is registered, unless there is a safeguarding reason.
* Appropriate welfare updates from care homes and professionals
* Stronger oversight of attorney decisions.
LPAs must protect individual choice while preventing misuse and unfair family exclusion.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to reform the Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) system in England and Wales to improve safeguards and accountability.

rejection.details:
I'm afraid we find large parts of this text unclear. 

"Appropriate welfare updates from care homes and professionals": to whom and in what context? 

Who do you want to have "oversight of attorney decisions."? Certain family members? A public body? Does oversight mean they get information or also powers to override the attorney(s)?

If you have concerns about a power of attorney that has been given to someone, then you may find this web-page useful: 

https://www.gov.uk/report-concern-about-attorney-deputy-guardian

You may also want to consider submitting a new petition which makes these points clearer.
